title: Finding
description: One place where admits(provider) is not decided to be a subset of admits(consumer), or a passing node worth a caveat (spec.md §4-§5). 'yes' is recorded only for the advisory/excluded-combination case (spec.md §5); every other 'yes' is not a finding at all.

path.description: The node's address, in shape spec §6.2's dimension-path grammar (e.g. 'response.body.status', 'response.body.items[*].qty').

verdict.description: The walk's own three-valued answer at this node (shape spec §8). 'yes' appears only alongside severity 'advisory' and a non-empty 'excluded-by' (spec.md §5) — every other finding is 'no' or 'unknown'.

severity.description: Computed once from 'verdict' and stored, so policy dispatch (spec.md §7) never re-walks the tree: 'finding' for 'no', 'review' for 'unknown', 'advisory' for a caveated 'yes'. Policy (spec.md §7.1) dispatches only on 'finding' and 'review' — 'advisory' is never blocked on.

kind.description: The mechanical classification (spec.md §4.2). Open: a component operator with its own comparability declaration may contribute a kind not in the core list.

reason.description: Free text naming the specific comparison that produced this verdict, e.g. '4 options vs 3' or 'two different regexes: conservative class, no guessing'.

excluded-by.description: Advisory cross-reference to the consumer contract's recorded exclusions whose dimensions overlap this path (spec.md §5). Never changes 'verdict'. Each item is design 2.3's Exclusion document (sampling-policy schema), reproduced here and not otherwise interpreted.

Side.title: Side
Side.description: One side's rendering of the node being compared, generated deterministically from its operator and parameters (spec.md §4.4) so two checkers agree on the text.

shape.description: The raw shape node, for a reader who wants more than the summary. Design 2.2's document, opaque here.
